turns.user: ok so a few things, I'm starving today so I think I need more carbs, what should I have before training tomorrow morning, and is it fine that I skipped the stretching at the end yesterday
turns.reply:
Add a large sweet potato to your meal today to refill the glycogen stores your legs emptied yesterday, though extra rice or whole-grain bread works too. 🍌

For tomorrow morning, a banana 30–45 minutes before training gives you quick-digesting energy without sitting heavy while you train.

Post-workout stretching feels nice and helps relax the nervous system, but it doesn't reduce soreness or drive muscle adaptation, so skipping it once won't hurt your progress at all.
